messages:
emma_sales: quick heads-up — FinSafe wants a short technical POC. Requirements: EU-only data residency, BYO-KMS, tenant pinning so traffic never leaves EU. Also asked for final subprocessors list (they want no US-based processing). Need scope, rough cost uplift, and timeline.

oscar_se: Q: Hosted + EU pinning acceptable or insist on Dedicated/Private? Also is control-plane EU-only required or just data-plane?

emma_sales: Hosted preferred but buyer is nervous. Ideally control-plane EU-only too, but they said data-path is the hard constraint. They want subprocessors list before legal signs SOW.

liam_eng_ops: Feasible but tradeoffs: Hosted + tenant pin routes data to EU region (eg eu-central-1) but control plane may still touch global infra unless we provision a private control plane. Dedicated/Private gives full EU control plane and can avoid cross-border backups if configured — recommended for strict no-US requirement.

liam_eng_ops: Ops config snippet:
region_pin: eu-central-1
fallback_policy: "eu-only"
allowed_subprocessors: ["aws-eu-central-1","azure-northeurope","datadog-eu","sentry-eu"]

liam_eng_ops: Notes: Telemetry vendors support EU-only endpoints but need opt-in. BYO-KMS supported via KMS-proxy/HSM; adds ~1-2 weeks for key setup and attestation. Also we may need a Private control-plane for cert chain and keystore localization.

liam_eng_ops: Cost (rough): Hosted with EU pinning + subproc whitelist: ~+15-25% unit uplift. Dedicated: one-time provisioning + monthly reserved cost; need QPS and token volume to estimate.

jana_product: POC plan: 45-60 day sandbox in eu-central-1, BYO-KMS staging flow (stub keys), tenant pinning, runbook and success criteria. I can draft POC SOW template and checklist.

security_bot: Security checklist: DPA with subprocessors appendix, KMS attestation, network diagram showing egress paths, SOC2 report, pen-test summary. If client insists zero-US subprocessors, we must validate EU-only processing modes per vendor and capture attestations.

emma_sales: Next steps: 1) I'll confirm with FinSafe whether Hosted with EU-only control-plane is acceptable or they need Private. 2) @liam_eng_ops draft ops handoff, subprocessors CSV (region+endpoint+contact), and two pricing scenarios by EOD. 3) @jana_product prep POC SOW template and legal pre-req list.

liam_eng_ops: On it. I'll include a short runbook, subprocessors CSV, and pricing delta with assumptions. ETA ~6 hours.

emma_sales: Thanks all — I'll update FinSafe and report back. :thumbsup:
